title: Diagnostic eprintln! panics the host when stderr cannot be written (12 panics in termal-state-lock-diagnostics, 2026-11-11 08:29:53Z)
outcome: Background diagnostic logging never panics when stdout or stderr is unavailable; the failed write is dropped (or counted), and the host keeps running.
acceptance: The state-lock diagnostics reporter and other background-thread diagnostic writes use a non-panicking stderr write, so an unwritable stderr drops the message instead of panicking.
A behavioural test with a writer that fails shows that the reporter keeps running and records no panic.
The remaining eprintln!/println! sites that run on long-lived background threads are listed on this item, each one either converted or recorded with a reason.
